types.name: input.Button
types.doc: A press or release of `button` at `(x, y)` in UI logical pixels.

fields.name: serial
fields.doc: The `wl_pointer.button` serial natively, 0 elsewhere: a window move or resize the press asks for must carry it (section 7).

types.name: input.Chunk
types.doc: A piece of an accepted file (section 6).

fields.name: file
fields.doc: The file's index in the `Drop` that was accepted.

fields.name: offset
fields.doc: The offset of `bytes[0]` in the file.

fields.name: bytes
fields.doc: At most `drop.chunk_cap` bytes, valid only while the chunk is dispatched.

types.name: input.ChunkEnd
types.doc: Whether a chunk is the last of its file, and how the file ended.

types.name: input.Drop
types.doc: The files of one drop at `(x, y)` (section 6).

fields.name: count
fields.doc: Files listed in `files`.

fields.name: skipped
fields.doc: Files not listed: over `drop_files_max`, over the host's name room, or not local files.

types.name: input.DropFile
types.doc: One file of a drop (section 6).

fields.name: name
fields.doc: The base name, valid UTF-8; path bytes that are not are shown as '?'.

fields.name: size
fields.doc: The bytes the transfer delivers: the size when the files were dropped.

fields.name: readable
fields.doc: False for a directory, a special file, or a path that could not be examined.

types.name: input.Event
types.doc: One input fact, in the order the platform observed it.

fields.name: drop_over
fields.doc: A drag carrying files is over the window at the point.

fields.name: drop_leave
fields.doc: That drag left the window, or ended, without dropping here.

fields.name: drop
fields.doc: It dropped here; valid only during the dispatch.

fields.name: file
fields.doc: Bytes of an accepted file; valid only during the dispatch.

fields.name: close_requested
fields.doc: The window manager asks the window to close: it closes unless the app calls `cx.keep_open()` during this event (`ui/cx.zig`, section 5a).

fields.name: window_state
fields.doc: The window's state changed (section 7).

fields.name: touch_down
fields.doc: A finger landed, moved, lifted, or was taken by the system (section 9).

types.name: input.Key
types.doc: The keys widgets name.

types.name: input.KeyPress
types.doc: A key press or release.

types.name: input.Mods
types.doc: Modifier keys held during an event.

fields.name: meta
fields.doc: Super on Linux, Command on a Mac.

types.name: input.Point
types.doc: A point in UI logical pixels.

types.name: input.Touch
types.doc: A finger at `(x, y)`.

types.name: input.TouchEnd
types.doc: A finger lifted: `wl_touch.up` has no position, so the contact's last one stands.

types.name: input.Wheel
types.doc: One wheel sample: the pointer anchor `(x, y)` in UI logical pixels and the scroll deltas.

types.name: ui.Align
types.doc: Where children sit in leftover space, per axis, from 0 (start) to 1 (end).

types.name: ui.Area
types.doc: One hit area.

fields.name: first_point
fields.doc: A path area's points in the point pool; `point_count == 0` for a box area.

fields.name: zoom
fields.doc: Screen pixels per world pixel of the canvas it was recorded in, 1 outside one: a path area's points are in world pixels (section 3a).

types.name: ui.CanvasState
types.doc: What one canvas keeps between frames.

fields.name: x
fields.doc: The exact offset in logical pixels and the zoom (section 2).

fields.name: drawn
fields.doc: The view the last frame drew with; events map through it.

fields.name: grab
fields.doc: The pointer during a pan drag.

types.name: ui.Cursor
types.doc: The pointer shape over an area.

types.name: ui.Decorations
types.doc: Who draws the window's title bar and frame.

types.name: ui.DragEnd
types.doc: How a drag ended, for its source: the target it was dropped on (`.none` when it was released over nothing or cancelled), and whether Escape or the pointer leaving the window cancelled it.

types.name: ui.DragHit
types.doc: What a pointer event (or Escape) means for one id during a drag between widgets.

fields.name: drag_in
fields.doc: The drag moved onto the target.

fields.name: over
fields.doc: The drag moved while over the target.

fields.name: drag_out
fields.doc: The drag moved off the target, was cancelled, or was released elsewhere.

fields.name: dropped
fields.doc: The drag was released over the target.

fields.name: ended
fields.doc: To the source: the drag is over after this event.

types.name: ui.DragOver
types.doc: A drag over a target or dropped on it: the pointer, the target's rect at the last draw, the payload, and the source.

types.name: ui.Dragging
types.doc: A drag between widgets in flight (section 7b): its source and payload, the pointer, and the target under it (`.none` when there is none).

types.name: ui.Flags
types.doc: What an area takes besides presses and hover.

fields.name: focusable
fields.doc: A left press focuses the area, and Tab visits it in draw order.

fields.name: tab
fields.doc: While the area is focused, Tab and Shift+Tab go to its widget (an editor indents) instead of moving focus.

fields.name: drop
fields.doc: The area takes dropped files: the topmost one under a file drag is its target.

fields.name: window
fields.doc: The window part a press on the area moves or resizes; `none` for a widget's area.

fields.name: drag_target
fields.doc: The area takes drags between widgets: the topmost one under a drag session is its target (`ui/cx.zig`, section 7b).

fields.name: primary_only
fields.doc: A press by any contact but the primary one treats the area as absent (`ui/cx.zig`, section 5b): for a widget of several ids that shares press state.

types.name: ui.Flow
types.doc: How a container lays out its children.

types.name: ui.Hit
types.doc: What one event means for one id.

fields.name: secondary
fields.doc: A right press on the hot area.

types.name: ui.Id
types.doc: A stable widget identity.

types.name: ui.Layout
types.doc: How a container places its children.

types.name: ui.Press
types.doc: A press or drag sample, with the rect of the area that was hit at the last draw, the press count of the click sequence, and the modifiers.

types.name: ui.Size
types.doc: How one axis of a walk is sized.

types.name: ui.Up
types.doc: A release sample.

types.name: ui.ViewState
types.doc: What one view keeps between frames.

types.name: ui.Walk
types.doc: One child's request: its two spans and its margins, none by default.

types.name: ui.WindowPart
types.doc: The part of the window an area stands for: a press on it goes to the compositor as a move (`drag`) or a resize from that edge (`ui/cx.zig`, section 5a).

types.name: ui.WindowRequest
types.doc: What the app or a window area asked of the window manager (module guide, section 5a).

fields.name: move
fields.doc: Move the window with the pointer, from the press with this serial.

fields.name: resize
fields.doc: Resize the window from `edge` (never `none` or `drag`), from the press with `serial`.

fields.name: menu
fields.doc: Show the window manager's window menu at the point, for the press with `serial`.

fields.name: toggle_maximize
fields.doc: Maximize, or restore while maximized.

fields.name: close
fields.doc: End the app: the host leaves its loop.

types.name: ui.WindowState
types.doc: The window's state from the window manager (section 7).

types.name: ui.cx.DropHit
types.doc: What a file-drag event means for one id.

fields.name: drop_in
fields.doc: The drag moved onto the area.

fields.name: drop_out
fields.doc: The drag moved off it, left the window, or ended.

fields.name: file
fields.doc: A chunk of a file the id accepted.

types.name: ui.cx.Dropped
types.doc: A drop on an area: the drag's point, the area's rect at the last draw, and the files.

types.name: ui.cx.Overflow
types.doc: What the last draw refused (module guide, section 10): instances (`draw.overflow_count`), areas (`area_overflow`), and glyphs the atlas could not fit, for lack of room; and icons whose face does not map their codepoint (`text.icon`), with the last as `face << 21 | codepoint`.

types.name: ui.cx.TouchInfo
types.doc: The finger whose event is being dispatched, from `cx.touch()`.

fields.name: target
fields.doc: The area under the press (`.none` when there was none, or `primary_only` hid it).

fields.name: joined
fields.doc: The target was held by the mouse or another contact when this one landed.

fields.name: time_ms
fields.doc: The time of this event: the host's stamp.

types.name: ui.cx.TouchPhase
types.doc: Which part of a touch the event being dispatched is.

types.name: ui.cx.TouchPlan
types.doc: The pointer events a touch event means (module guide, section 5b): one, or two for a lift.

functions.name: ui.Context
functions.doc: The UI context over the draw context type `Draw`.

functions.name: ui.id
functions.doc: The id of item `index` of the kind `name`.

functions.name: ui.sized
functions.doc: A walk with no margins: `.{ .width = width, .height = height }`.

functions.name: ui.flow_of
functions.doc: A layout with no spacing, padding, alignment, or clip, flowing by `flow`: `.{ .flow = flow }`.

functions.name: ui.route
functions.doc: Calls `handle(cx, event)` on every widget `target` names and returns how many returned something other than `.none` (module guide, section 3a).

functions.name: ui.overlays
functions.doc: Calls `draw_overlay(cx)` on every widget `target` names, in the order `route` would visit them (module guide, section 3b).

functions.name: ui.dispatch
functions.doc: Resolves `event` once and lets the app route it.

functions.name: ui.animate
functions.doc: Dispatches `.frame` and returns true while a widget keeps animating.

functions.name: ui.draw_frame
functions.doc: Draws the app when a draw is owed, then re-resolves hover.

functions.name: ui.Context(...).init
functions.doc: Initializes the draw context and an idle UI state that owes its first draw.

functions.name: ui.Context(...).timer_setup
functions.doc: Records the app's timer period and whether the timer runs from startup; the hosts call it once after `init` (section 9).

functions.name: ui.Context(...).set_timer
functions.doc: Starts or stops the host timer.

functions.name: ui.Context(...).theme_setup
functions.doc: Records the app's starting scheme; the hosts call it once after `init` (section 9b).

functions.name: ui.Context(...).theme
functions.doc: The app's scheme, which widgets read their colors, text styles, and weights from (section 9b).

functions.name: ui.Context(...).set_theme
functions.doc: Switches the app's scheme: stores it, gives the draw context its record, and owes a draw, which the renderer turns into one uniform write and a full repaint (section 9b).

functions.name: ui.Context(...).overflow
functions.doc: What the last draw refused (section 10).

functions.name: ui.Context(...).overflow_report
functions.doc: The last draw's overflow when it differs from what this last saw and is not all zero, else null, so a persistent overflow is reported once and again whenever it changes.

functions.name: ui.Context(...).redraw
functions.doc: Marks a draw as owed.

functions.name: ui.Context(...).keep_animating
functions.doc: Asks the host for another frame because an animator is still moving.

functions.name: ui.Context(...).hovered
functions.doc: The hovered id: the one the last event left hot, frozen while a capture is held.

functions.name: ui.Context(...).begin_frame
functions.doc: Resets the draw context and the areas for a window of `width` by `height` logical pixels at `scale_120`, and pushes the root turtle.

functions.name: ui.Context(...).end_frame
functions.doc: Ends the frame.

functions.name: ui.Context(...).drawing
functions.doc: The draw context, for `text.place` and app-defined appends.

functions.name: ui.Context(...).append
functions.doc: Appends one instance through the draw context.

functions.name: ui.Context(...).walk
functions.doc: Places a leaf for `walk` in the current container and returns its border box.

functions.name: ui.Context(...).begin
functions.doc: Opens a container for `child` laid out by `layout` and returns its border box (a fit axis is 0 until `end`).

functions.name: ui.Context(...).end
functions.doc: Closes the current container: aligns its children, resolves fit sizes, aligns itself, and advances its parent.

functions.name: ui.Context(...).skip
functions.doc: Advances the current container's cursor by `span` without a child.

functions.name: ui.Context(...).peek
functions.doc: The border box the next child for `child` would get, without placing it.

functions.name: ui.Context(...).fits
functions.doc: True when the next child for `child` would fit the current container.

functions.name: ui.Context(...).remaining
functions.doc: The space the next child of the current container could use.

functions.name: ui.Context(...).clip
functions.doc: The clip in effect, or null when it is empty.

functions.name: ui.Context(...).visible
functions.doc: The clip in effect when `rect` has positive edges and overlaps it, else null: the cull test widgets apply before drawing.

functions.name: ui.Context(...).begin_view
functions.doc: Opens a scrolling view for `child`.

functions.name: ui.Context(...).begin_view_with
functions.doc: `begin_view` whose own area carries `flags` (which take the wheel): a list box makes its view focusable, so Tab reaches it and its keys follow focus.

functions.name: ui.Context(...).end_view
functions.doc: Closes the current view: stores the measured content height, advances the parent, and draws the thumb with its area when the content can scroll.

functions.name: ui.Context(...).begin_canvas
functions.doc: Opens a canvas for `child` (section 3a): `layout.padding` insets the viewport, the canvas's own wheel and pan area `id` covers it, and `layers` (1 to 4, none the base layer) get `state`'s view this frame.

functions.name: ui.Context(...).end_canvas
functions.doc: Closes the open canvas: restores the layer and the glyph zoom and advances the parent by the canvas's walk.

functions.name: ui.Context(...).canvas_view
functions.doc: The view of the open canvas, or null outside one.

functions.name: ui.Context(...).begin_at
functions.doc: Opens a container at `rect` (fixed on both axes) in the current coordinates, laid out by `layout`, outside its parent's flow (section 3b).

functions.name: ui.Context(...).begin_popup
functions.doc: Opens popup `id` at `rect` (section 3c): switches to `Layer.popup`, appends a dimmed face over the window when `dim > 0` (its alpha), records the backdrop area `popup_backdrop(id)` over the whole window, and opens a free container at `rect` laid out by `layout` under the window clip.

functions.name: ui.Context(...).end_popup
functions.doc: Closes the open popup and restores the layer it opened over.

functions.name: ui.Context(...).popup_backdrop
functions.doc: The id of popup `id`'s backdrop area, which takes every press outside the popup.

functions.name: ui.Context(...).request_popup
functions.doc: Notes that popup `id` opened and owes its first draw: safe builds check at the end of that draw that its owner drew it or skipped it (section 3c).

functions.name: ui.Context(...).skip_popup
functions.doc: Notes that the owner of popup `id` reached it this frame but drew nothing, because its anchor was not drawn (section 3c).

functions.name: ui.Context(...).area
functions.doc: Records a hit area for `id` over `rect` with corner `radius`, under the clip in effect, on the current layer.

functions.name: ui.Context(...).path_area
functions.doc: Records a path area for `id`: the points within `width / 2 + path.hit_slop` of the path `placed` (from `draw.path`, this frame) under the clip in effect, on the current layer (`ui/areas.zig`, section 3).

functions.name: ui.Context(...).find
functions.doc: The area recorded for `id` at the last draw, or null.

functions.name: ui.Context(...).area_list
functions.doc: The areas of the last draw, in append order.

functions.name: ui.Context(...).touch_live
functions.doc: True when contact `id` is down (so a repeated down must cancel it first).

functions.name: ui.Context(...).contacts_live
functions.doc: Contacts down now.

functions.name: ui.Context(...).touch_ids
functions.doc: The ids of the live contacts, in table order, into `out`; how many there are.

functions.name: ui.Context(...).touch
functions.doc: The finger whose event is being dispatched, or null for the mouse and for any other event (section 5b).

functions.name: ui.Context(...).holds
functions.doc: True when the mouse or any contact holds `id` (a capture), in any phase.

functions.name: ui.Context(...).touch_begin
functions.doc: Starts a touch dispatch: finds or claims the contact `event` is for, loads its pointer state, and returns the pointer events it means (section 5b), or null when the event is for no contact (an unknown id, a 17th finger, a cancel of nothing).

functions.name: ui.Context(...).touch_end
functions.doc: Ends a touch dispatch: the mouse's state is back, and a lifted or cancelled contact is free (section 5b).

functions.name: ui.Context(...).event_begin
functions.doc: Starts dispatching `event`: stores the pointer and resolves the hot area and the wheel target once (section 5), and applies focus, keys, and window focus (section 7).

functions.name: ui.Context(...).event_end
functions.doc: Finishes dispatching: a left release or a leave drops the capture, and an Escape press clears focus after the widgets saw it (section 7).

functions.name: ui.Context(...).hit
functions.doc: What `event` means for `id`.

functions.name: ui.Context(...).drop_hit
functions.doc: What the file-drag event `event` means for `id`.

functions.name: ui.Context(...).drop_hovering
functions.doc: True while a file drag is over `id`'s area (section 7a).

functions.name: ui.Context(...).drop_wanted
functions.doc: Host side: true while a file drag is over a drop target, so a drop here would be taken (the native host accepts the offer, the browser shows a copy cursor).

functions.name: ui.Context(...).accept_files
functions.doc: Takes the files in `mask` of the `drop` being dispatched; `id` receives their chunks (section 7a).

functions.name: ui.Context(...).cancel_files
functions.doc: Ends the files in `mask` of the running transfer: each that has not ended gets one `cancelled` chunk after the current dispatch (section 7a).

functions.name: ui.Context(...).take_files_accept
functions.doc: Host side: the mask of an `accept_files` during the last dispatch, once.

functions.name: ui.Context(...).take_files_cancel
functions.doc: Host side: the files `cancel_files` asked to end since the last call, once.

functions.name: ui.Context(...).drag_begin
functions.doc: Starts a drag between widgets from `source`, which holds the capture, carrying `payload` (section 7b).

functions.name: ui.Context(...).dragging
functions.doc: The drag between widgets in flight, or null (section 7b).

functions.name: ui.Context(...).drag_hovering
functions.doc: True while a drag between widgets is over `id`'s area (section 7b).

functions.name: ui.Context(...).drag_hit
functions.doc: What `event` means for `id` during a drag between widgets.

functions.name: ui.Context(...).focused
functions.doc: True when `id` has keyboard focus.

functions.name: ui.Context(...).focus_gained
functions.doc: True during the event that gave `id` focus.

functions.name: ui.Context(...).focus_lost
functions.doc: True during the event that took focus from `id` (a press elsewhere or Tab).

functions.name: ui.Context(...).set_focus
functions.doc: Gives `id` focus, as a widget that opens an editor does.

functions.name: ui.Context(...).clear_focus
functions.doc: Clears focus, as a field does when Enter commits.

functions.name: ui.Context(...).focused_rect
functions.doc: The focused area's rect at the last draw that recorded it (section 7).

functions.name: ui.Context(...).held
functions.doc: True while `key` is held.

functions.name: ui.Context(...).consumed
functions.doc: True when the last key press went to a widget or moved focus (section 7).

functions.name: ui.Context(...).cursor
functions.doc: The pointer shape to show (section 8).

functions.name: ui.Context(...).copy
functions.doc: Stores `utf8` (cut to `clipboard_cap` on a codepoint boundary) for the host to offer as the clipboard selection.

functions.name: ui.Context(...).copied
functions.doc: The bytes of the last `copy`.

functions.name: ui.Context(...).take_copy
functions.doc: Host side: true once after a `copy`.

functions.name: ui.Context(...).request_paste
functions.doc: Asks the host for the clipboard text; it arrives as a `paste` event.

functions.name: ui.Context(...).take_paste_request
functions.doc: Host side: true once after a `request_paste`.

functions.name: ui.Context(...).window_state
functions.doc: The window manager's last word on the window (section 5a).

functions.name: ui.Context(...).minimize
functions.doc: Asks the window manager to minimize the window.

functions.name: ui.Context(...).toggle_maximize
functions.doc: Asks the window manager to maximize the window, or to restore it while maximized.

functions.name: ui.Context(...).close
functions.doc: Ends the app after the current event (natively; the browser ignores it).

functions.name: ui.Context(...).keep_open
functions.doc: Cancels a pending close: during `close_requested`, the window stays.

functions.name: ui.Context(...).take_window_request
functions.doc: Host side: the request the last dispatches left, once (section 5a).
